notes: Identity verified in supplied canonical excerpt: title Uncertainty, expertise, and persuasion: A replication and extension of Karmarkar and Tormala (2010), authors Erik Løhre, Subramanya Prasad Chandrashekar, Lewend Mayiwar, Thorvald Hærem, JESP 113 (2024) 104619, DOI 10.1016/j.jesp.2024.104619 (p. 1, L0–L64). Published primary empirical Registered Report with actual Results, not a preregistration. Cache contains PDF-derived web excerpts (L0–371 and L488–896), not the complete 13-page paper. No local PDF supplied; no acquisition performed. Only assigned replication fields assessed. 257 high-certainty participants + 253 low-certainty participants = 510 participants. These are mutually exclusive final certainty groups within the direct-replication 2 × 2 model, not the whole-study recruitment N = 1018. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom. No partial eta squared or numeric p for this main effect is printed in the supplied involvement section. The printed F bound is retained without converting it or attaching the interaction p = .030. The N sum is the shared direct-replication model sample supported by final certainty groups and retention of all participants, not a sum of involvement-specific separately printed cell counts.
